t: You're at Oxford Circus Underground station, in the Central London Railway building at the north-east corner of Argyll Street and Oxford Street. There are offices above the station. Two architects are credited with designing it: Harry Bell Measures, who lived from 1862 to 1940, and Delissa Joseph, who lived from 1859 to 1927. Measures was an English architect, and Joseph was British. The material I have doesn't say more about either man, so that's all I can tell you.
